excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

protocol.arrival_model: independent class-wise Poisson arrivals using the existing aligned-frame stream key aligned-frame:{seed}:{coordinate}
protocol.common_tape_rule: construct exactly one tape for each (lanes, load, seed), then pass that identical immutable tuple to fixed and exact-reference runs
protocol.online_information: each selector call receives only the current released queue, lane count, fixed catalogue, and its registered LP budget
protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames, FIFO within class, arrivals during a frame become eligible only at the next frame boundary
protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at 600 seconds and drain the identical finite tape to completion under both policies

paired_mean_flow_noninferiority.estimand: arithmetic mean across arrival seeds of fixed-budget/exact mean-flow ratios on common tapes
paired_mean_flow_noninferiority.interval: one-sided Student t upper bound with Bonferroni alpha/family_size

protocol.trajectory_support_gate: for each case, the maximum fixed-budget returned gap/L1 over every visited frame and seed is strictly below the same-lane capacity eta
execution_gate: all registered jobs complete under both policies
queue recursion and FIFO flow decomposition are exact
every selected frame reconstructs and has a valid returned certificate
fixed per-frame LP calls do not exceed its registered budget
the K4096 reference is exact in every frame

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution checks fail
decision_rule.COUNT_SPACE_TRAJECTORY_TRANSITION_PASS: all four R/load cases pass paired mean-flow noninferiority and the trajectory support gate
decision_rule.COUNT_SPACE_TRAJECTORY_R8_ONLY_PASS_STOP: both R8 load cases pass but at least one R16 case fails
decision_rule.COUNT_SPACE_TRAJECTORY_R16_ONLY_PASS_STO: both R16 load cases pass but at least one R8 case fails
decision_rule.COUNT_SPACE_TRAJECTORY_TRANSITION_FAIL_S: neither lane count passes both registered load cases

protocol.claim_boundary: A registered finite-horizon paired trajectory comparison on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 models. It is not a uniform all-queue result, positive-recurrence proof, physical multi-GPU measurement, or deployment decision.
protocol.prohibited: post-result changes to seeds, horizon, loads, budgets, reference, margins, or endpoints; ordered-action or count-vector enumeration; future-arrival access by selectors; server data; paper or README edits

claim_boundary: A registered finite-horizon paired trajectory comparison on eight fresh Poisson seeds per load for synthetic identical-lane R8 and R16 models. It is not a uniform all-queue result, positive-recurrence proof, physical multi-GPU measurement, or deployment decision.
limitations: The four confidence bounds use eight seed-level ratios and the usual Student t approximation.
The finite 600-second arrival windows are drained completely but do not prove steady-state behavior.
The exact reference is exact for every visited frame under K4096, not a theorem that K4096 closes every queue.
Synthetic lane replication does not measure physical multi-GPU interference.
next_step: Preserve the failed case without changing seeds, budgets, or margins.
